audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged the chart: Gnar wins 52.81% but the chart handed Akali 4 of 7 stages to Gnar's 1. Level 3 was scored 'Akali' while its own why says the stage 'comes down to baiting the Shroud, so it's skill-dependent'.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is a 20/19/18/17/16s cooldown, not permanent cover; at 3 Gnar still holds a 1100-range Boomerang against her 550-range Q, so the stage is a bait contest rather than an Akali stage.
audit.corrected: Level 3 -> Skill (5/10) on both layers, leaving Gnar 2 / Skill 2 / Akali 3, which matches a 52.81% Gnar win rate.

audit.why: Spikes read correctly: Gnar 1-2 (Mini range before she has a Shroud charge or energy), Akali 6 (Perfect Execution, two charges, 120/90/60s), Akali first AP item, Akali late. Gnar's own spike is Rage-driven, not level-driven, which the prose already respects.
audit.corrected: No structural change; spikes[1] reworded for the correct ability name.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text wrote 'Twilight Shrouds' (packet suspectName). Assassin's Mark was absent everywhere, so nothing told the player that her burst opens with an auto-attack reset rather than an ability cast.
audit.why: Assassin's Mark rings a champion hit by spell damage; leaving the ring empowers her next attack with bonus range and damage, and it carries the autoReset flag. The wind-up on that attack is the real tell, and it is what makes 'just walk out' punishing.
audit.corrected: Correct name Twilight Shroud with its 20s rank-1 cooldown, and Assassin's Mark named as the poke follow-up in the don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is titled 'Get Q-poked down' but its detail text describes burning a cooldown for tiny value — the pair does not match.
audit.why: Inherited boilerplate. The real mistake is trading into the ring: Five Point Strike chip plus the Assassin's Mark empowered attack is her whole lane poke.
audit.corrected: Detail rewritten to describe the actual poke pattern.

edits.before: Her R gives two charges of a dash-and-execute kill window. If your Rage bar is empty and you're stuck in squishy Mini, she E-dashes in, Twilight Shrouds to dodge your Boomerang and go untargetable, and the second R execute finishes you.
edits.after: Her R gives two charges of a dash-and-execute kill window. If your Rage bar is empty and you're stuck in squishy Mini, she E-dashes in, drops Twilight Shroud (20s) to go untargetable, and the second R execute finishes you.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Akali must walk into your range.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud lands at 3 and eats your Boomerang — bait the smoke, then re-engage; it is a 20s cooldown, not a wall.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Q chip plus her Assassin's Mark empowered auto is the whole poke — deny the ring.
